newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Frugal Pakistan leader flies economy class.
newsitem.headline: Frugal Pakistan leader flies economy class.

text.p: Pakistan's new prime minister used his first trip on Thursday as a showcase for an austerity drive, shunning police protection and travelling in economy class.

Caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid flew to the provincial capital Lahore on Pakistan International Airlines flight 381, leaving behind the special plane his predecessors favoured, the state news agency APP said.
Khalid, who assumed office after former prime minister Benazir Bhutto was sacked on Tuesday, travelled in a single car to the airport instead of the usual convoy of police vehicles, APP said.

No guards lined the route to the airport, and Khalid used the ordinary lounge at Lahore airport instead of the VIP area, which was closed under an order passed by Khalid's cabinet at its first meeting on Wednesday.

At that meeting, the government cut minister's salaries in half as part of an austerity package aimed at trimming spending and checking the "VIP culture", which it said was at odds with Islamic culture and a democratic society.
Critics of Bhutto's government accused it of running up an onerous budget deficit with lavish spending.
